_meta.purpose: Central, updatable map of each city/town to its LOCAL news outlets and TV channels — the sources whose 'best of / things to do / hidden gems / fall fun' lists feed this guide. Tap these to search or refresh a city for site suggestions.
_meta.why: Local TV stations and papers run exactly the numbered/curated lists the methodology wants (e.g. News 5 Cleveland's '100 hidden gems', WKBN's fall-farm guide). Knowing a city's outlets up front makes discovery and refresh fast and repeatable.
_meta.howToUse: node tools/research.js --media <city-key> prints a city's outlets. Add/curate a city's outlets here before or while building it, and cite them in data/sources.json when they yield a place.
_meta.volatility: These CHANGE — stations rebrand, papers fold or merge, new nonprofit newsrooms and blogs appear. Treat this as living data: when you notice a change, update the entry and bump its 'updated' (and _meta.updated).
